Accepted interpretation binds exact request/evidence/clarification/assumptions/limitations/omissions and effective tenant-settings/capability versions; material change invalidates stale acceptance, while historical versions remain immutable.

An accepted partially deliverable scope can generate only supported meaning without invented data, permission, target-platform capability or hidden business fallback; safety and deterministic eligibility remain mandatory.

Server-authoritative tenant settings have validated effective versions, safe audit/history, OWNER/ADMIN mutation, consequence-aware warnings, immutable restore and protected masked secret replace/rotate; ordinary users and unauthorised experts cannot mutate or retrieve other-tenant settings or secrets.

Existing validated development configuration seeds explicit initial tenant settings once, including per-cycle 2 and overall 10; normal runtime uses persisted tenant versions rather than environment, Compose or browser copies. Missing/invalid critical configuration fails closed.

Generic Power BI namespace checking rejects source-column/measure and other collisions before package delivery, including Revenue/Revenue and unrelated regression fixtures, without business-name-specific logic or unvalidated meaning changes.

Every generated package includes the extended version-bound Delivery / Instruction Guide with accepted business meaning, limitations, omissions, standards and handover details but no credentials, raw model output or false deployment claim.
